text:
marie.prod: Hey team — after upgrading our service to the Python SDK 1.40.x, streaming generation latency blew up and we saw a billing spike. Anyone else hit this?

jordan_support: Oh no. Can you share a tiny repro and the pip package you installed?

marie.prod: We moved from 1.39.12 -> 1.40.2. Minimal repro (sanitized):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=... )
resp = client.chat.stream(model="open-beta-3", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"tell me a joke"}], stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk)
```

Observed: instead of small incremental token objects we're now getting larger repeated chunks and occasionally the client retries mid-stream. Logs show a few partial stream closes followed by a reopen and duplicate tokens. Example log snippet: `stream EOF, retrying, request_id=abc123`, then repeated token chunks.

alex_eng: Thanks — that helps. Two quick Qs: do you have any idempotency header set for streaming calls? and are you using the default retry behavior?

marie.prod: We don't set idempotency for streaming. Using default client config (no explicit retry overrides). Also seeing a 100-300ms extra latency per chunk, overall latency up 2-3x.

jordan_support: This matches another report we saw in triage. Looks like 1.40 changed the streaming payload shape + a subtle interaction with the client's retry-on-network-failure logic, which can trigger when a chunk boundary lands on a socket close. That can double-deliver some tokens if the app isn't deduping.

alex_eng: Escalating to eng: @alex_eng fyi — potential regression in 1.40 streaming + retry. Can you confirm?

alex_eng: Confirmed, we shipped a regression in 1.40. The server-side stream framing was tightened and the client retry logic treats a truncated chunk as retriable, which can cause duplicate content emission in some apps and extra billable tokens. Working on a fix now.

tara_sre: For immediate mitigation: 1) pin to 1.39.x (we recommend 1.39.12) 2) set retry attempts to 0 for streaming calls or add an idempotency header that your app can use to dedupe. Example workaround: 

```python
# pin in your deploy: pip install 'redwood-inference==1.39.12'
# or disable client retries for streaming calls
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., retry_policy={"max_attempts": 0})
```

marie.prod: OK we'll try pinning and toggling retries. Quick q: any ETA on a patched 1.40.x or a 1.40.3?

alex_eng: We're preparing a patch release today that restores the previous framing behavior and tightens partial-chunk retry detection. ETA ~4-6 hours. We'll post the release notes and migration guidance in this thread. :thumbsup:

jordan_support: For support ticketing & billing investigations, can you share a few request IDs and approximate times of the spike? That helps SRE correlate token accounting.

marie.prod: Sure — sample request ids: abc123, def456. Spike observed ~2026-03-16T14:10:00Z to 14:40:00Z. Logs attached in our private folder (shared with support).

jordan_support: Got it — we can open a billing inquiry if pinning doesn't resolve the bulk of the spike. One more: do you stream through a proxy/load-balancer? That sometimes causes more truncated-chunk cases.

marie.prod: Yes we route via an internal edge proxy but we tested direct to the API host and still saw the problem (smaller but still present).

alex_eng: Thanks — we'll include proxy tests in our CI repro. In the meantime, please do the pin + retry_policy change and report back. If you want, we can temporarily regress your tenant to 1.39-framing on the server side to avoid any billing impact while we cut the patch — need your OK to proceed.

marie.prod: Please regress us for now, that would be great. Also you have permission to pull the logs we shared with support.

ci-bot: deploy: rolling revert for tenant marie.prod initiated by alex_eng — job #4921 started.

jordan_support: Replied to billing team with request ids, will update once they confirm charge adjustments. Pinging when the patched wheel is published.

marie.prod: Thanks team — appreciate the fast triage. Will report back after we pin and test. :pray:
